title: Mechanical gimbal turntable (Blender + Cycles)
one_line: The DCC-MCP Blender adapter boots inside a real Blender 5.1.1 host, builds a 24-part gimbal assembly, and renders a hero frame plus a seamless 48-frame turntable.
capture_provider: Blender Cycles GPU render running inside the live host; turntable frames encoded to a 128-colour palettised GIF; contact sheet converted to JPEG q82 with Pillow

files.proves: the host really rendered the assembly: 1600x900, mean luma 53.8, 72.9 percent of pixels lit, subject centred at uv (0.516, 0.629)
48 rendered frames, every inter-frame step non-zero, and the loop seam statistically indistinguishable from any other step
eight evenly spaced samples across the rotation cycle, so the motion claim can be checked by eye without scrubbing
the entry is reproducible: re-rendering this scene regenerates both the hero frame and the 48 turntable frames
